description: Extract driving, walking, bicycling, and transit directions between two locations from Google Maps, or build a distance/duration matrix across many origins and destinations.

avoidFerries.description: Driving mode only — avoid routes that use ferries.
avoidFerries.title: Avoid Ferries

avoidHighways.description: Driving mode only — avoid highways/motorways when possible.
avoidHighways.title: Avoid Highways

avoidTolls.description: Driving mode only — avoid toll roads when possible.
avoidTolls.title: Avoid Tolls

departureTime.description: Optional ISO 8601 datetime (e.g. 2026-06-16T10:30:00) used for transit routing.
departureTime.title: Departure Time (Transit)

destination.description: Ending location — full address, place name, or 'lat,lng' coordinate pair. (mode=route)
destination.title: Destination

destinations.description: Ending locations for the matrix — each a full address, place name, or 'lat,lng' coordinate pair. One row is returned per origin × destination pair. (mode=matrix)
destinations.title: Destinations

language.description: Language of the directions page (affects step instructions text).
language.title: Language

maxPairs.description: Upper bound on the total number of origin × destination pairs the actor will request in matrix mode. Origins × destinations is truncated to this value so a large matrix cannot run away. (mode=matrix)
maxPairs.title: Max Pairs

mode.description: Operation mode. 'route' returns route alternatives for a single origin -> destination; 'matrix' returns one row per origin × destination pair across many origins and destinations.
mode.title: Mode

origin.description: Starting location — full address, place name, or 'lat,lng' coordinate pair. (mode=route)
origin.title: Origin

origins.description: Starting locations for the matrix — each a full address, place name, or 'lat,lng' coordinate pair. One row is returned per origin × destination pair. (mode=matrix)
prefill: Grand Central Terminal, New York, NY
origins.title: Origins

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional fallback proxy. The actor first tries without a proxy (more reliable for Google Maps); proxy is used only if the no-proxy attempt fails.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration

units.description: Preferred distance units. Google Maps may still localise based on the route's country.
units.title: Units

title: Google Maps Directions Scraper
